code: (async()=>{const c=document.querySelector('canvas');const gl=c.getContext('webgl2')||c.getContext('webgl');const w=c.width,h=c.height;const mk=()=>new Uint8Array(w*h*4);const rd=(b)=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>{gl.readPixels(0,0,w,h,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,b);r();}));const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const A=mk(),B=mk();await rd(A);await rd(A);await wait(450);await rd(B);const L=(b,i)=>0.2126*b[i]+0.7152*b[i+1]+0.0722*b[i+2];let changed=0,tot=w*h;const bright=(b)=>{const s=new Set();for(let y=0;y<h;y++)for(let x=0;x<w;x++){const i=(y*w+x)*4;if(L(b,i)>150)s.add(y*w+x);}return s;};for(let p=0;p<tot;p++){const i=p*4;if(Math.abs(L(A,i)-L(B,i))>12)changed++;}const sa=bright(A),sb=bright(B);let same=0;for(const p of sa){if(sb.has(p))same++;}return {pctChanged:Math.round(changed/tot*10000)/100,brightA:sa.size,brightB:sb.size,brightSamePixel:same,brightOverlapPct:sa.size?Math.round(same/sa.size*1000)/10:0};})()
